build.beforeBuildCommand: pnpm --filter @rfhold/waltr-web build:tauri && node scripts/stage-web.mjs && node scripts/stage-native-apps-test.mjs
build.beforeDevCommand: pnpm --filter @rfhold/waltr-web build:tauri:dev && node scripts/stage-web.mjs && node scripts/stage-native-apps-test.mjs

security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src ipc: http://ipc.localhost; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-src http://127.0.0.1:*/container.html http://127.0.0.1:*/probe/container.html; form-action 'none'
